dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, please. Something is wrong with my phone.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈpliːz. ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪz ˈrɔːŋ wɪð maɪ ˈfoʊn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Is anything wrong with the screen?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ˈɛniθɪŋ ˈrɔːŋ wɪð ðə ˈskriːn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, there's nothing wrong with the screen. But the battery is always empty after two hours.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ðɛrz ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈrɔːŋ wɪð ðə ˈskriːn. bʌt ðə ˈbætəri ɪz ˈɔːlweɪz ˈɛmpti ˈæftər ˈtuː ˈaʊərz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not very well. It's very old.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈvɛri ˈwɛl. ɪts ˈvɛri ˈoʊld.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I checked everything. You just need a new charger.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈtʃɛkt ˈɛvriθɪŋ. juː ˈdʒʌst ˈniːd ə ˈnuː ˈtʃɑːrdʒər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! Do you have anything cheap?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! duː juː ˈhæv ˈɛniθɪŋ ˈtʃiːp?
